name: list_union_variant_hint_resets_per_inner_list
description: UNION BURN-DOWN — the hint's SCOPE. list<list<int | float>> over [[1.5],[9007199254740993]]: each inner array starts its own last_union_hint at None (coerce_array/try_cast_array are per-array), so the float arm chosen inside the FIRST inner list does NOT reach the second one and 2^53+1 keeps full precision. Contrast list_union_variant_hint_float_arm, where both elements share one array. Pins that native resets the hint at every array boundary rather than threading it globally. want live-captured from BAML v0.223 final parse.
